evidence.quote: the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate to 2 to 2-1/4 percent
will act as appropriate to sustain the expansion, with a strong labor market and inflation near its symmetric 2 percent objective
On a 12-month basis, overall inflation and inflation for items other than food and energy are running below 2 percent.
The Committee will conclude the reduction of its aggregate securities holdings in the System Open Market Account in August, two months earlier than previously indicated.
In light of the implications of global developments for the economic outlook as well as muted inflation pressures

parsed.rationale: The statement announces a rate cut citing global risks and muted inflation, keeps an easing-leaning 'act as appropriate' guidance, and ends balance sheet runoff early. A strong labor market description and two dissents favoring a hold temper the dovish signal somewhat.
